caption: The drawing depicts a single, large, metal teapot shown in profile, oriented with its curved spout to the right and an ornate handle to the left. The teapot is rendered in grayscale tones, with detailed shading that suggests a reflective metallic surface. The body of the teapot is rounded and bulbous at the base, tapering upwards to a domed lid topped by a spherical knob finial. The handle is dark, pronounced, and sweeping, forming a large curve with a spiral at both ends. The spout is elongated, elegantly curved upward near the tip, and attached just below the lid. In the upper right corner of the drawing, there is an inset sketch of the same teapot, smaller in scale, annotated with two horizontal and vertical measurements (7 1/2 and 3 1/4). The background is plain, with the objects outlined in fine lines, and there is an artist’s signature, “H. Reina,” in the lower right corner. The drawing is bordered by a rectangular frame.
title: Silver Teapot
